title: Carson Block警告：AI或引发下一场金融危机
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We invent and innovate, I think we understand the risks and how to manage them, find out we don't, we have some kind of calamity.
segments.zh: 我们发明创新，自认了解风险并懂得管理，但发现并非如此时，就会引发灾难。

segments.en: But on the back end we say okay, now we've learned.
segments.zh: 事后我们却说，好吧，现在学到了。

segments.en: But the problem is when you have these machines building the next generation of machines, the rate of change will increase in terms of the improvement of capability,
segments.zh: 但问题是，当这些机器开始制造下一代机器时，能力提升的速度会越来越快。

segments.en: we are in my view just not going to be able to adapt ourselves quickly enough to catch up.
segments.zh: 在我看来，我们根本无法足够快地适应并跟上。

segments.en: So there will be new jobs created and there will be people, you know, I think a small number of people who are at the forefront of understanding how to use these technologies.
segments.zh: 会有新工作出现，也会有一小部分人站在理解如何运用这些技术的前沿。

segments.en: And, you know, they'll be okay, but, you know, for the rest of us I, you know, I just don't think that's going to be the case.
segments.zh: 他们或许没问题，但对于我们其他人来说，情况恐怕并非如此。

segments.en: Welcome to Merrin Talks Money, the podcast in which people who know the markets explain the market, I am Merrin Zums at Web.
segments.zh: 欢迎收听《Merrin谈钱》，这档节目由了解市场的人解读市场，我是Merrin Zums at Web。

segments.en: And this week I am speaking with Well-known short seller and Muddy Waters Capital founder and CEO, Carson Block.
segments.zh: 本周我邀请到知名做空者、浑水资本创始人兼CEO Carson Block。

segments.en: Carson, welcome to Merrin Talks Money.

Thank you. Thanks for having me. You have been talking a lot recently about AI and I wanted to just start on that straight away because I think the core of your view is that AI really is going to live up to everyone's expectations over it.
segments.zh: 谢谢。最近你频繁谈论AI，我想直接从此切入，因为我认为你的核心观点是AI确实会达到所有人的预期。

segments.en: It is going to be spectacularly successful.
